steps.en: Install the app (installer on Windows/macOS, Flathub on Linux)
steps.zh: 装好应用（Windows/macOS 用安装包，Linux 用 Flathub）

steps.en: Open a file or disc folder as the source
steps.zh: 打开一个文件或光盘目录作为源

steps.en: Scans titles, chapters, audio and subtitle tracks
steps.zh: 扫描出标题、章节、音轨和字幕轨

steps.en: Pick a preset and the tracks, then add the job to the queue
steps.zh: 选预设和要保留的轨道，把任务加进队列

steps.en: Decodes, filters and re-encodes with the encoder the preset names (x264, x265, SVT-AV1 or GPU)
steps.zh: 用预设指定的编码器（x264、x265、SVT-AV1 或 GPU）重编码

steps.en: Muxes the result into an MP4, MKV, WebM or MOV file
steps.zh: 封装成 MP4、MKV、WebM 或 MOV 文件

value.en: Smaller files that play on your devices, at a quality decided once in a preset — no encoder flags to learn
value.zh: 更小、各设备都能播的文件，画质在预设里一次定好，不用学编码参数

sources: https://github.com/HandBrake/HandBrake README @ de24f9c (2026-10-08) and 1.11.0 release notes (MOV container, ProRes, DNxHR; FFmpeg 8.0.1 decoding); docs introduction/about.markdown (video is always converted)
